sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at the office. Going to debrief with Night shift and then gear up to go and patrol.
Heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square and doing welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks, Queen Street McDonald's all clear. Localito and 77 Convenience Stores have just opened. Continuing to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing a sweep of the area.
Aotea Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Federal Street via Wellesley Street.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal Street. Welfare checks completed from Eighty Fed, Coffee Club, both 77 Convenience Stores, and News Agency Store. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Wyndham Street via Federal Street.
Standing by at the corner of Wyndham and Albert Street. Welfare check on Cathedral Church all clear, no issues, standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart all clear. Continuing towards Lower Albert.
Arrived at Lower Albert, on standby at Commercial Bay for security presence.
No issues at Commercial Bay. Now heading to Gore Street.
Gore Street all clear upon standing by at Auckland Harbour Suites.
Heading to patrol Fort Street for a welfare check.

Chargrill, Jo & Joe's, Evan's Kebabs, KFC, Right Track and Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues. We received a call from a member of the public in regards to vagrants being an issue. We arrived and spotted the male; the female stated that he has been yelling and swearing. Police spoke to him already about his volume and behaviour. Standing by at Pocket Park. (photo and video on file)
Poi has moved to Commercial Bay. Standing by for security presence.
Poi has gone towards the basketball area where the ferry terminal is. Heading back up Queen Street.
Welfare checks on businesses from Q Convenience Store up to Vulcan Lane. Stores are okay, no issues were brought up to us. Heading up to complete High Street patrols.
High Street all clear. We have Opportunity Party in Freyberg Square. Standing by for security presence. (photo on file)
Heading to check on Chancery Square and O'Connell Street.
Chancery Square and O'Connell Street all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to Lorne Street via High Street.
High Street patrol completed along with Lorne Street, all complete and clear. No issues to report. Heading towards Elliott Street via Wellesley Street.
Elliott and Darby Street all cleared. Standing by for security presence.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep showing security presence.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, no issues to report.
Check-in corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield / Library, no issues.
Heading back down Wellesley, patrolling Queen Street.
Check-in Queen Street McDonald's / Avachi / Localito / Cue City / Footlocker / Unichem / Ippondo, no issues.
Check-in Woolworths / Chemist Warehouse, no issues.
Check-in Coffee Club / 77 Convenience Store, no issues.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham Street, also welfare checks Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu / Mac Pac, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 30 minutes break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Changeover with Morning shift completed. Charging ops phone due to low battery.
Ops phone is charged and at a sufficient battery level.
Commencing patrols from headquarters onto lower Queen Street areas, heading towards Commercial Bay with welfare checks completed on stores along the way.
Commencing foot patrols from Headquarters, making our way towards Commercial Bay with welfare checks on stores along the way.

We received a call from Footlocker Queen Street; the staff requested our assistance in removing a male from the store who was being verbally aggressive and extremely difficult, making our way over there now.
We received a call back from Footlocker informing us that the male has already left the store. No further issues to report. Making our way over towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay area completed, standing by maintaining presence.

While standing by outside Britomart McDonald's, there was a little altercation with a large group of teenagers on bikes and an old intoxicated vagrant; we intervened and calmed down the intoxicated vagrant and told him to move along. We told the teenagers on the bikes to move along as well. Standing by maintaining presence.
Police activity Commercial Bay, standing by maintaining security presence.
Heading towards Victoria Street via Albert Street. Welfare checks completed on:
Arrived at Victoria Street, welfare check completed on Albert Mart and the liquor store on Victoria Street, standing by maintaining presence and monitoring foot traffic.
Heading over to Aotea Square for a full sweep.
Arrived Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed, maintaining security presence whilst walking down Queen Street and awaiting response calls.

We received a response call from a bar restaurant on Vulcan Lane called The Queen's Ferry regarding a female vagrant who kept yelling at customers and was verbally abusive towards staff members. Making our way over now.
The female vagrant left long before our arrival. Standing by outside the bar restaurant maintaining presence.

Received a call from Kumi Desserts near Courthouse Lane regarding a male vagrant sleeping inside the store on the chairs. While making our way over to Kumi Desserts, we received a few calls at once that did not require urgent assistance and were shortly resolved after.

Arrived at Kumi Desserts; we approached staff members and briefly talked with them and they directed us to the vagrant who was sleeping. We approached the male vagrant and asked him to leave the premises, he complied, no further issues to report. Standing by outside store maintaining presence.
Heading over towards Chancery Square for a full sweep.
Arrived Chancery Square, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Chancery Square completed, no issues to report, heading over to Commercial Bay via High Street.
Sweep High Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Fort Street / Fort Lane, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Gore Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Customs Street East, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay completed, no issues to report, standing by maintaining presence. Welfare checks completed on:
Heading back to headquarters for floor checks.
Arrived at headquarters, commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Standing by charging ops phone.
Ops phone is charged and at a sufficient battery level, heading downstairs to commence patrols.
Commencing patrols from headquarters, heading towards Aotea Square for a full sweep.
Welfare check on Queen Street McDonald's, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing a full sweep of the whole area.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed, standing by maintaining presence due to a lot of foot traffic in the area.
Heading down to Commercial Bay via Queen for a final sweep and monitoring foot traffic and public activity along the way.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, welfare check completed on Britomart McDonald's, commencing a full sweep of the surrounding area.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay completed, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence.
Heading back to headquarters to start our 30-minute scheduled break.
Arrived at headquarters, starting our 30-minute scheduled break.
Afternoon shift concluded, handover to night shift completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:40 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Check-in at Chemist Warehouse & Kathmandu. All clear, no issues.

Staff at The Fiddler called in regard to a male that has been frequenting the establishment throughout the day, drinking his own alcohol at the bar and making racist & derogatory remarks against patrons at the bar. Description provided was a Maori male with a black hat & black puffer jacket. The male also has knuckle busters on. (video on file)
Staff at The Fiddler called back relaying that the male they informed us about earlier was now making threats of a gun. Staff were advised to contact police immediately.

Arrived at The Fiddler. Cops arrived at the same time & were quick to locate the male who had just walked into the 77 Convenience Store on Federal Street. Cops arrested the male on sight. Visual ID has been taken for Auror report. Standing by to show security presence & if further assistance is needed.
Victoria Street West all clear. No more issues at The Fiddler. 77 Convenience Store also all clear. No further issues. Heading down Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear. Active presence of vagrants in the area, more active than usual at this time. Vagrants are not causing any issues. Moving down towards Mayoral & Albert Street.
Arrived at intersection between Mayoral & Albert Street. Area is quieter than Federal. Moving along towards the Civic.
Arrived at the Civic. Footwork has calmed down towards this side of the area. Not many people in sight. Heading down Queen Street.
Welfare check on McDonald's Queen Street. No issues to report. Continuing patrols down Queen Street.

Arrived at intersection at Victoria Street West & East. Things seem to have calmed down after the prior incident. Vagrants still in eye view of the area but are not causing any trouble. Continuing down Queen Street.
Arrived at Wyndham Street. Quick sweep was done at Durham Street West along the way. Area is relatively quiet. Standing by shortly awaiting response calls.
No concerns in the area at this point in time. Continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Arrived at TK Square. Patrolling Commercial Bay. Commencing full sweep.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. No issues to report. Commercial Bay all clear.
Quay Street all clear. AA & Provador no issues. Stood by to show presence at the bars briefly before continuing patrols. Heading through Commerce Street towards Fort Lane.
Commerce Street all clear. Cutting through Fort Street back on Queen Street.
Fort Lane all clear. Back on Queen Street heading towards Vulcan Lane.
Vulcan Lane all clear. No concerns in the area. Heading up High Street towards Lorne Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street. Area all clear. Heading back to office for floor checks.
Back at HQ commencing floor checks.
Floor checks complete. On standby at HQ charging ops phone. Awaiting response calls.
Phone percentage sufficient enough to re-continue patrols.
Heading back out for patrols. Heading towards Darby Street.
Darby Street all clear. Heading up Elliott & Atrium.
Area secure & all clear. Cutting through Wellesley Street West towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Standing by awaiting response calls.
Aotea all clear. Vagrants sleeping in the area. Area isn't busy at this time. No issues to report on. Continuing patrols.
Check-in corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield / Library, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Lorne Street / High Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Gore Street, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Britomart McDonald's / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Quay Street / check-in corners Providor / AAS, no issues to report.
Welfare check marina guards, no issues. Heading towards Federal Street.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Durham Street, no issues. Heading up Victoria Street.
Check-in 77 Convenience Store, no issues. Patrolling Federal heading towards Wellesley.
Federal Street / Wellesley Street all clear, no issues.
Check-in Queen Street McDonald's, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 30 minutes break.
